newThemes.name: September Regime: Bond Selloff + Oil Inflation + Crowded Positioning
newThemes.status: Active tactical regime / high cross-asset impact
newThemes.summary: US and Japanese yields are breaking higher while Brent/diesel remain tight and active-manager exposure is elevated. This is not automatically a crash signal; it raises the penalty on leverage and duration while rewarding current cash flow, scarcity and stock selection.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: US 10Y is around 4.76–4.78%, Japan 10Y reached 3%, and a secondary reproduction shows NAAIM exposure at 102.7. Visible Hormuz commodity transits remain far below normal. FXEvolution's claimed record QQQ block is retained as an unverified flow warning only, with zero direct score impact.
watch: QQQ/SPY breadth rather than seasonality alone

mainNews.title: Bond selloff deepens as rising energy prices stoke inflation fears
mainNews.implication: Higher real and nominal yields raise the discount-rate hurdle across Power Stack while strengthening the scarcity/cash-flow preference.

mainNews.title: Oil rises as renewed fighting revives supply-disruption risk
mainNews.implication: Persistent Hormuz disruption keeps the energy inflation channel alive even as high prices create demand-destruction risk.

newThemes.name: Software Relative Strength vs Hardware
newThemes.status: Early rotation / selective, not blanket SaaS
newThemes.summary: Software is beginning to separate from semiconductors beneath a relatively range-bound index. The useful signal is not 'AI saves all SaaS' but that platforms with real AI monetisation, security or workflow control can rerate while hardware leadership cools.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: FXEvolution highlighted the relative rotation; independent chart research shows equal-weight software near a record monthly close while positioning had been skewed toward semiconductors. Higher bond yields still argue for quality and cash flow rather than indiscriminate multiple expansion.

mainNews.title: Equal-weight software worked toward its highest monthly close while positioning remained skewed toward semis
mainNews.implication: Relative strength and positioning support a selective software rotation hypothesis, but it remains subordinate to earnings quality and rates.

newThemes.name: Energy Security: Americas Crude + US LNG
newThemes.summary: The Iran/Hormuz shock is accelerating a geographic rerouting of energy supply toward the Americas. This can outlast the immediate conflict and benefits infrastructure tied to reliable crude, LNG and long-haul logistics rather than only short-lived spot-price beta.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: Reuters estimates Americas crude exports at a record 11.7 mbpd in 2026 as buyers diversify away from Gulf concentration. Global LNG security risk is simultaneously raising the strategic value of US export capacity.

mainNews.title: The Americas' oil bonanza may outlast the Iran conflict
mainNews.implication: Energy-security diversification can create a durable demand shift toward Western Hemisphere barrels and infrastructure.
